In this video: This is one of the rare times (so far) that I'm not putting up OC but mirroring someone else's documentary. 

"September 11: The New Pearl Harbor" (2013) by Massimo Mazzucco is a 5 hour documentary in 7 parts (Air Defense, The Hijackers, The Airplanes, The Pentagon, Flight 93, The Twin Towers, and Building 7) which summarizes 12 years of public debate on 9/11. All the most important issues in the debate are presented in full detail, showing both the positions of those who reject the official version, the 9/11 Truth Movement, and the positions of those who support it, called "the debunkers." You can be the judge. - IMDB summary

In my opinion, the evidence here shows that the official story of the 9/11 terror attacks was completely impossible and fake -- but also more than that, that the nature of the evidence shows without a doubt that the only possible way that what happened on 9/11 could have happened was from the inside of the US government and military, most likely by a far-right faction with close ties to the Bush administration.
